title: Northwind Labs: Search decision record
body:
Status: Decided 2026-10-03
Owner: Dave
Accountable: Alice

Decision
Typesense self-hosted replacing the Algolia trial

Why
Cost/data stays in our cloud/typo tolerance

Rollout
October 28 behind search_v2 with Erin adding alerts on query latency above 200 ms

Open questions
Index sharding past 5M documents, who pays for the extra node
